Geographies in the NYC crosswalks

Source: R/data.R
nyc_xwalk_geographies_df.Rd

The fifteen geographies in the crosswalk tables, with the source and release of the boundaries used for each.

Usage

nyc_xwalk_geographies_df

Format

nyc_xwalk_geographies_df

A tibble with 15 rows and 10 columns:

geo_id

Geography ID used in the crosswalk tables (character): cd community districts, pp police precincts, dsny sanitation districts, fb fire battalions, sd school districts, hc health center districts, cc city council districts, nycongress congressional districts, sa state assembly districts, ss state senate districts, bid business improvement districts, nta 2020 Neighborhood Tabulation Areas, zipcode Modified ZIP Code Tabulation Areas, hd historic districts, ibz industrial business zones.

geo_name

Name of the geography (character).

source

Publisher of the boundaries: NYC Department of City Planning, NYC Open Data, or NYC Economic Development Corporation (character).

name_field

Field in the source data used for feature names (character).

name_alt_field

Field used for alternate names, where there is one (character).

source_url

URL from which nycbuildxwalks downloaded the boundaries (character).

cycle

DCP release cycle of the boundaries, e.g. "25d", for DCP sources (character). NA for other sources.

n_features

Number of boundary features (integer).

n_names

Number of distinct feature names, i.e. features after dissolving by name (integer).

run_date

Date on which nycbuildxwalks downloaded the boundaries and built the crosswalks (Date).

Source

NYC Department of City Planning, BYTES of the BIG APPLE, https://www.nyc.gov/content/planning/pages/resources. NYC Open Data, https://opendata.cityofnewyork.us. NYC Economic Development Corporation, https://edc.nyc. The registry comes from nycbuildxwalks, which adapts it from the MODA-NYC crosswalks tool, https://github.com/MODA-NYC/nyc-geography-crosswalks.

Details

nyc_xwalk_df gives the credits for the crosswalk method.
